datasets.title: Gabon: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: TThe world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in Gabon: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49). There is also a tiled version of this dataset that may be easier to use if you are interested in many countries.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/highresolutionpopulationdensitymaps-gab]

lineage.description: High-resolution population density maps were produced by applying machine learning algorithms to commercial satellite imagery to identify building footprints across Gabon. These footprints were then combined with national census data and demographic statistics in partnership with Columbia University to redistribute population counts at fine spatial resolution. The resulting gridded datasets provide demographic-disaggregated population estimates (overall, women, men, children, youth, elderly, women of reproductive age) for 2020 in both GeoTIFF and CSV formats.

sources.name: AI and Data for Good at Meta (Facebook)
sources.description: Machine learning-based building detection from commercially available satellite imagery used to spatially distribute population estimates at high resolution.

sources.name: Columbia University
sources.description: Provides population disaggregation methodology overlaying general population estimates based on publicly available census data and population statistics onto the building footprint layer.
